s.note: Garlicky udon with sesame and scallion.
s.how: Whisk the soy, sesame oil, honey and garlic together. Cook the udon in boiling water until loose and tender, then drain. Toss the hot noodles in the sauce. Pile into small bowls and finish with spring onion and sesame seeds.

s.note: Creamy chicken leek pies in puff pastry.
s.how: Brown the chicken in the butter, then add the leek and carrot and cook until soft. Stir in the flour, then the stock and cream, and simmer until thick. Stir in the peas, season and spoon into 4 small ovenproof dishes. Top each with a round of pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C until puffed and golden. Rest for 5 minutes and serve.

m.note: Loaded pepperoni pizza with extra cheese. Nick's pizza night at home.
m.how: Heat the oven as hot as it goes with a tray inside. Stretch the dough into 2 rounds and spread with sauce. Top with mozzarella, pepperoni, mushrooms and oregano. Bake on the hot tray until blistered and bubbling. Drizzle with oil and cut into slices.

m.note: Crisp fish, slaw and lime crema tacos.
m.how: Stir the sour cream with the zest and juice of a lime. Whisk the flour, paprika, a pinch of salt and the soda water into a light batter. Dip the fish and fry in hot oil in batches until crisp. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan. Fill with cabbage and fish, add the crema and finish with coriander and lime.

w.note: Strawberry and yogurt ice pops in paw moulds.
w.how: Blend the strawberries with the honey and apple juice until smooth. Layer the strawberry mix and yoghurt in ice pop moulds, swirling with a skewer. Push in the sticks and freeze until solid.

d.note: Carrot, orange and ginger topped with soda, a giant can from the ZPD machine.
d.how: Stir the carrot juice, orange juice, ginger and honey together. Pour over ice in 4 tall glasses and top with soda.
